items.text: Career guidance after BBA is built for the specific fork management graduates actually face: whether an MBA now genuinely strengthens your direction, a direct management or functional role, a deliberate specialization skill stack, or joining the family business.

The point is to choose the path tied to a real, high-value skill portfolio instead of treating BBA as only a stepping stone, so this stage starts unlocking stronger income opportunities and earlier financial freedom.
Not a generic post-graduation question, the exact fork between an MBA, a direct job, a specialization, and the family business that a BBA specifically raises.
